svg.title: Three plugin axes
svg.desc: Three orthogonal axes describe every plugin: boot_layer for load order and disableability, tier for capability and licence, origin for provenance. They are never conflated.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each plugin has a position on all three. They answer different questions and are checked by different code.
